test_title: PYST 4: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:13 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The knowledge and abilities that students are expected to master as they __progress through__ the four years of high school are referred to as the high school curriculum.
solution:
The correct answer is: **'advance through'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence is: **'advance through'.**
 
• The underlined segment in the given sentence** 'progress through'** will be **'advance through'** as we use progress to suggest movement or advancement through a series of events, or points in time; development through time. On the other hand we use advance to suggest a forward move.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'regress along'** means o return to a former state or condition, and not usually in a good way.
 
• **'grow with'** means undergo natural development by increasing in size and changing physically.
 
• **'deteriorate over'** means to become impaired in quality, functioning, or condition.
